Hi all — quick legal summary after a preliminary review of MedTrack's MSA redline (attached). Key items:

- Data residency: MedTrack proposed adding a UK-specific residency clause. We flagged that as an exception; if their residencies are US-only for now, we can limit scope in the OF.
- Indemnity cap: Their redline increases the cap; we have proposed language to cap at 3x fees.
- Billing & tax section: Need clarity whether MedTrack requires Redwood to populate tax jurisdiction at invoice time or if they will calculate taxes on their side.

On provisional activation: we can allow a limited manual PO ingestion lane if the customer signs the Order Form and provides a written risk acknowledgement for any outstanding MSA items. Full automated Ariba integration (vendor portal, electronic PO reconciliation) requires the vendor registration to be completed and the Order Form executed.

Action for MedTrack: please sign the Order Form via DocuSign (link to be provided by Vivek) and confirm whether they will accept Redwood-generated taxJurisdiction text, or if MedTrack prefers to compute taxes downstream.

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline_MedTrack_review.pdf

Hi Haley — thanks for the template, looks good. A few specifics from the Ariba side and how Redwood consumes PO data:

- GL mapping: we require a GLCode field (string) on the header level. If your Ariba instance places GL codes at the line-item level, include a header-summary GLCode in the CSV export.
- Tax jurisdiction: Redwood expects a tax_jurisdiction string (e.g., "US-CA" or "UK-ENG"). If Ariba provides nested taxJurisdiction objects, include a pre-mapped text column called tax_jurisdiction_text in your export.
- PO number & supplier id: critical for reconciliation; please ensure the "SupplierLocationID" field is present.

Workarounds while portal is live: we can do manual ingestion of CSVs on a nightly cadence for the initial 2 weeks post-OF signature. That will let AP start receiving POs while we complete the Ariba vendor activation. I attached a sample ingestion CSV (MedTrack_Ariba_Mapping_Template_v2.csv) with example rows.

If MedTrack can provide one test PO by EOD Monday (6/7), I will run it through the ingestion and report back with any parse exceptions.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
